::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru-based ASIC design services firm founded 2018. Won the Ministry of Defence's iDEX challenge in March 2019 and co-develops hardware security solutions with Indian Defence under Make in India.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Custom ASIC design/turnkey services, plus its own hardware-only security ICs (VLSI-only, no software layer) designed to eliminate software-based backdoors.
